classification.difficultyReason: Compute f×x for each column, sum, count the total and divide. This is the same procedure as p38-q3, with a different dot plot and no starter products.

content.prompt: Write $f\times x$ at the top of each column, find the sum, then calculate the mean.

answer.worked:
The products above the columns are $3,4,12,20,15,18$.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Sum of data values}&=3+4+12+20+15+18\\\text{Sum of data values}&=72\\\text{Number of data values}&=3+2+4+5+3+3\\\text{Number of data values}&=20\\\bar{x}&=\frac{72}{20}\\\bar{x}&=3.6\end{aligned}$$
